correct_completion: a few of them still failed the test.
full_sentence: Although many students studied hard, a few of them still failed the test.
acceptable_variants: a few of them still did not pass.
some of them still got low marks.

options.text: so all of them passed easily.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, but 'although' requires a contrast with the first clause.

options.text: all of them got top marks.
options.why_wrong: This continues the expected result of hard study instead of contrasting with it.

options.text: a few of them still failed the test.
none of them wanted to study.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the first clause, which says the students studied hard, so it is not a logical contrast.

grammar_focus: Concessive clauses with 'although' and quantifiers (many, a few)
explanation: After 'although', we need a clause that contrasts with the first part of the sentence. The quantifier 'a few' contrasts with 'many' in the stem.
translation: Embora muitos alunos tenham estudado muito, poucos deles ainda foram reprovados na prova.
